# Audit of the story sets (2026-11-10)

What was checked, how, and what was **not** checked. 142 stories: Vishnu 68 (3 are catch-all placeholders), Shiva 20, and 54 in the six newer sets.

## Summary

| Layer | Method | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Lyric quotes, song titles, index counts (all 142 files) | every quoted line must occur in `songs.lyrics_list` of that song; header titles must equal the DB; STORIES.md counts must equal the file | see section 1 |
| Tamil devotional refs (Shiva 211, Vishnu 157) | cited opening words must occur on the cited page (Tamil script, or transliteration skeleton for koyil.org) | section 2 |
| URL vs reference number (252 entries) | pasuram/pathigam numbers in the URL must equal the cited ref | section 3 |
| Sanskrit/Puranic refs (Shiva 52, Vishnu URL-bearing) | Mahabharata lines exist in the GRETIL text; Bhagavata `Text N` and Valmiki shlokas exist on the page; wisdomlib chapter number equals the ref | section 4 |
| Vishnu Valmiki / Kamba / Bhagavata / Mahabharata verse numbers (194 refs) | `build_ramayana_verses.py`, `build_krishna_verses.py`, `build_avatar_verses.py` fail if a verse or line is missing; all three pass and change no output | section 5 |
| New sets (54 stories) | 66 verse/padalam citations re-checked on every build against cached texts | section 6 |
| All 293 reference URLs | each answers HTTP 200 | section 7 |

## Fixed during this audit

- `avatar-narasimha`: Nanmugan Thiruvandhadhi 18 pointed at an unrelated page (Periya Thirumozhi 2.6) and was marked unseen. The real page was found (`2018/07/nanmugan-thiruvandhadhi-18/`), it describes Narasimha splitting Hiranya's chest; now confirmed.
- `avatar-brahma-origin`: Periya Thirumozhi 5.4.1 was a candidate with the page unopened; the page was opened and its first verse matches; now confirmed.
- `krishna-mortar-bound`: Periya Thirumozhi 11.5.5 was marked confirmed but its URL is the 8.2.5 page that only quotes it (the 11.5.5 page is not yet on the site); now a candidate.
- New sets: wrong song assignments removed earlier the same day (see each story's 'Hand-read notes').

## Known limits and open items

- Shiva: 200 of 211 Tamil references are confirmed, the rest are labelled candidates. Vishnu: 144 of 157.
- Checks prove that a verse, chapter or page **exists and carries the cited words**. They do not prove that the one-line gist is correct; gists were written from the pages when they were opened.
- Within a Tevaram pathigam page the cited verse's position (e.g. verse 4) is not checked, only that the opening words occur on the pathigam's page.
- Kamba and Valmiki numbers for Vishnu are checked for existence, not that the verse says what the story file says; the earlier sessions chose them by reading.
- Valmiki 1.36.5-18 (Shiva, Skanda's birth): shloka 15 is not separately labelled on valmikiramayan.net; the range ends are verified.
- Periyazhwar Thirumozhi 4.7.7 is spelled 'viRpidiththu' on the page and 'வில்பிடித்து' in the data; same words, verified by eye.
- Wisdomlib (31 refs): only the chapter number was checked, not the content.
- Sources never opened and labelled 'from memory' in the new sets: Devi Mahatmya Sanskrit text (could not be fetched), Tiruvasagam, Tirumurugatruppadai, Adi Ula, Sangam poems.
- The Yuddha Kandam and later Kanda Puranam kandams are not on Wikisource, so the war, Valli and Deivayanai stories cannot be checked against the text.
- Song-to-story assignments: Shiva and Vishnu were hand-read in the earlier sessions; the new sets were read and corrected but the large Murugan lists were read only where doubtful.

## Rebuilding the cache

`python -I scriptures/scripts/audit_urls.py` writes the URL list; fetch each into `scripts/.cache/audit/<first 16 hex of sha1(url)>.html` (a one-line curl loop). The other caches: `pp_all.json` (thevaaram.org Periya Puranam, ids 12000+10n), `tvp.json` and `kp_verses.json` (Tamil Wikisource), `mbh_NN.html` (GRETIL, via `fetch_krishna.py`).
